$description: Fresh Orbit illustration slots (D53). Every image the apps show fills one slot. Edit scene, alt, characters or style here, then run `pnpm --filter @fresh/illustrations prompts` to rebuild the prompts and `pnpm --filter @fresh/illustrations validate`. To use a final image: save assets/<slot_in_lower_snake_case>.png, set file to it and status to FINAL, then run `optimize`. See README.md.

FISHMONGER.name: Padma
FISHMONGER.description: An Indian woman, about 30, warm brown skin, a small dark bindi and a bright friendly smile; a coral headscarf over a low black bun; a white short-sleeve kurta under a glossy sea-teal fishmonger apron, with a coral skirt hem showing below it; light-blue rubber gloves; dark-green rubber boots; she often holds a fresh silver fish; same face, headscarf and clothes as in the approved character sheet in every picture

RIDER.name: Ravi
RIDER.description: A man, about 26, with a short beard and moustache and a cheerful smile; a sea-teal helmet with a clear visor; a teal rain jacket with silver reflective stripes; an ice-blue insulated backpack with a white snowflake mark; dark cargo trousers and white sneakers; rides a coral-orange electric scooter; same face and clothes as in the approved character sheet in every picture

SUPPORT_AGENT.name: Anil
SUPPORT_AGENT.description: A man, about 32, with wavy black hair and round thin glasses, calm and kind; a teal polo shirt, navy trousers with a brown belt and white sneakers; a slim black headset with a small microphone; same face, hair and clothes as in the approved character sheet in every picture

HOME_COOK.name: Ammamma
HOME_COOK.description: A grandmother, about 65, with silver hair in a bun, a red bindi and a warm knowing smile; a mango-yellow saree with a coral border over a coral blouse, gold bangles and a thin gold necklace; she carries a steel pot and a ladle; same face, hair and clothes as in the approved character sheet in every picture

POMFRET.name: Chanduva
POMFRET.description: A round silver pomfret fish with big glossy eyes, rosy cheeks and an open happy smile, using its fins as hands; a friendly character, never food; same look as in the approved character sheet in every picture
